description: Get a bounded elevation GeoTIFF from OpenTopography for terrain analysis where an appropriate local DEM is unavailable. Supply WGS84 bbox [west,south,east,north] covering at most 100 km² and dataset; UK projects should prefer Defra 1 m LiDAR DTM. BYO OpenTopography key only; commercial use requires an OpenTopography Enterprise key. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Requires a TerraMCP Bearer key from https://terramcp.earth/account and your own OpenTopography key.

bbox.description: WGS84 bounds [west, south, east, north], ordered and covering at most 100 km².

dataset.description: Dataset identifier from the allowed values in this schema.

name: dem_clip
